title: Flight recorder — spans du pipeline
description: P95 par agent, coût par analyse et taux d'erreur, depuis l'hypertable agent_span. Versionné en fichier : une perte du volume grafana_data ne l'efface plus.

list.name: project
list.label: Projet
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM agent_span ORDER BY 1

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM agent_span ORDER BY 1

panels.title: P95 de durée par agent
panels.description: Les spans « llm » sont exclus : leur durée est dominée par le modèle, pas par l'agent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
       agent AS metric,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95
FROM agent_span
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND project = '$project'
  AND span_kind = 'agent'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Taux d'erreur par agent (%)
panels.description: status <> 'ok' — couvre error et timeout. S'appuie sur l'index partiel agent_span_errors_idx.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
       agent AS metric,
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'ok') / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS taux_erreur
FROM agent_span
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND project = '$project'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Coût estimé par analyse (USD)
panels.description: ESTIMATION à tarif catalogue (ModelPricing.java, table illustrative), jamais une dépense constatée. Les modèles locaux y figurent à 0.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(cout) AS "Coût moyen par run"
FROM (
  SELECT run_id, sum(cost_usd) AS cout
  FROM agent_span
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND project = '$project'
  GROUP BY run_id
) parRun

SELECT avg(entree) AS "Entrée", avg(sortie) AS "Sortie"
FROM (
  SELECT run_id, sum(tokens_in) AS entree, sum(tokens_out) AS sortie
  FROM agent_span
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND project = '$project'
  GROUP BY run_id
) parRun

panels.title: Analyses (runs)
panels.description: Une analyse en deux process produit deux racines sous un même run_id : on compte les run_id, pas les racines.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT run_id) AS "Analyses"
FROM agent_span
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND project = '$project'

panels.title: Dernier run — arbre run → agents → appels LLM
panels.description: Même requête que monitoring/flightrec/replay_last_run.sql : récursion amorcée sur TOUTES les racines du run.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE dernier_run AS (
    SELECT run_id FROM agent_span
    WHERE project = '$project' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
),
arbre AS (
    SELECT s.span_id, s.parent_id, s.time, s.agent, s.span_kind, s.name,
           s.status, s.duration_ms, s.tokens_in, s.tokens_out, s.cost_usd,
           0 AS profondeur, s.name AS racine, ARRAY[s.time, s.time] AS tri
    FROM agent_span s JOIN dernier_run d USING (run_id)
    WHERE s.parent_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
    SELECT e.span_id, e.parent_id, e.time, e.agent, e.span_kind, e.name,
           e.status, e.duration_ms, e.tokens_in, e.tokens_out, e.cost_usd,
           a.profondeur + 1, a.racine, a.tri || e.time
    FROM agent_span e
    JOIN arbre a ON e.parent_id = a.span_id
    JOIN dernier_run d ON d.run_id = e.run_id
)
SELECT racine AS "Phase",
       repeat('    ', profondeur) || span_kind || ' · ' || name AS "Arbre",
       agent AS "Agent",
       status AS "Statut",
       round(duration_ms::numeric, 1) AS "Durée (ms)",
       NULLIF(tokens_in, 0) AS "Jetons entrée",
       NULLIF(tokens_out, 0) AS "Jetons sortie"
FROM arbre ORDER BY tri, time

panels.title: Durée des appels LLM (P50 / P95)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('$__interval', time, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) AS time,
       percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS "P50",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS "P95"
FROM agent_span
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND project = '$project' AND span_kind = 'llm'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: P50/P95 de la durée des appels LLM. time_bucket_gapfill + spanNulls=false : une tranche sans appel apparaît comme un trou, pas comme un segment reliant les points voisins.
